title: Invincible
subtitle: Naval Adversary
text:
If you control a unique Separatist card, this unit costs 1 resource less to play.
When you deploy a leader: You may return a non-leader unit that costs 3 or less to its owner's hand.
rules:
Abilities that refer to a card’s cost always refer to its printed cost, regardless of modifiers.
Abilities that return a card to hand must choose a card in play unless otherwise specified.
(ERRATA) Templating update: “Unique” becomes “<uq>”.
